claim_text: The Template as Cognitive Lens Each template embodies a distinct way of seeing and interacting with code: - `code-map.md` treats code as a graph of relationships (nodes as components, edges as data flow) - `data-explorer.md` sees code through the lens of structured transformation (SQL/API/pipeline patterns) - `concept-map.md` frames code as a knowledge domain to be explored and mapped - `document-critique.md` and `diff-review.md` both focus on evaluation but through different mechanisms—structured suggestions vs.
